result.quote: A son named Josiah will be born to the house of David, and upon you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense upon you, and human bones will be burned upon you.
result.reason: The key is supported as a paraphrase of one part of the proclamation, but the question asks broadly what the man of God cries out. The same speech also announces Josiah’s birth and the sacrifice of the priests, so several materially different answers are defensible. The question should narrow the request, such as asking what will be burned upon the altar.
